headline: Petrol Could Exceed 10 Lei and Diesel 11 Lei per Litre in the Coming Days
summary: Consultancy Frames warns petrol could exceed 10 lei per litre and diesel could reach 11 lei in the coming days. The forecast is tied to Gulf region developments and the Middle East conflict.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into Romanian inflation, transport costs and household spending, and they track global crude and refined product markets.
